page.layout: One page of text (left printed page, a dictionary of Greek entries); a narrow column of marginal notes at the right edge, partly cut off by the binding. Running head centred at top, page number top left.

main_text.p: Ναῦς νεὼς ἡ navis. in Accusativo ναῦν.
Ναύκληρος ὁ nauclerus, qui navem possidet, qui est navis heres & dominus. κληρος ὁ fors, hereditas, Act.27.11.
Ναύτης ὁ nauta. Latini poetae, navita.
Νεανίας ὁ adolescens. à νέων ἀνὴρ ὁ juvenis, quod est à νέος ὁ novus.
Νεκρὸς ὁ ἀν mortuus a um. ab adj. νεκυς ν. ε mortuus, unde est vox Latina nex necis g.f.
Νεκρόω ω mortifico, interimo. F.ωσω. P.νενεκρω-μαι. aor.1.act. ενεκρωσα. a.1.imperat. νεκρωσον ἁτω ατε. prat.pass. νενεκρωμαι. νενεκρωμένος ὁ ον emortuus.
Νέος α ον novus a um. item adolescens, juvenis Tit.2.4. comparat. νεώτερος α ον junior, minor natu. pl.num. οἱ νεώτεροι juvenes Act.5.6. εἰς νεωτέρας juvencula, juniores, minores natu, 1.Tim.5.11.
Νεοσσὸς ὁ Attice νεοττὸς ὁ pullus.
Νεότης ἡ juventus. ἐκ νεότητος ἀ juventute.
Νεόφυλος ὁ ἡ nuper confitus, recens plantatus, q.d. νέον φυτὸν nova planta per metaph. novitius, tiro.
Νέω innuo cum Dat. Fut. νεύσω. P. νένευκα. a.1. ἐνεῦσαι. part.a.1.act. νεύσας αὐτὸς ὁ.
Νεφέλη ης ἡ nebula, nubes. νεφέλαι ἀνυδροι nubes aqua carentes.
Marginal notes at the right edge are largely illegible and cut off by the binding; not transcribed.

page.notes: Right margin notes are mostly illegible (cropped, small, and overlapping the binding). Several Greek words are uncertain and marked by their nearest reading; the word after Νέφω is partly cut off at the foot.
